utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I meant to bring something, but I forgot what it was. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: If you can, just bring any spare tools or hardware you’ve got. Even a small donation would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I can do that — I’ll check my shed and bring whatever spare tools or screws I can find.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I might’ve missed the details, but what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Mostly just helping hands and any spare tools you’ve got. I’ll send the details again so you don’t miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — send it again and I’ll keep an eye out. I can bring a few tools and help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How’s the repair drive going, Uli?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s going, thanks for asking. I’m just taking it one step at a time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Glad to hear it. What’s the next thing you’re tackling?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m spreading the word about the repair drive now — if you can make it, I’d love to see you there!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks for the heads-up, Quinn — I’ll keep an eye out for the details and see if I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll send the details as soon as they’re set — hope you can join us!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive, Hana. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Sam — could you help me double-check the list of needed repairs and supplies before we start?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — send me the list and I’ll double-check it with you.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help out—what's the repair drive need most?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s kind of you, Leo — we need hands for small home fixes, tool sorting, and checking in on folks who can’t manage repairs themselves.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can do the tool sorting and a few small fixes. Tell me where to start.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I can help coordinate the repair drive. What do you need from me, Bo?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Rosa — just help spread the word and keep a list of what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course — I’ll spread the word and start a list of repairs. Send me anything you hear, and I’ll keep it organized.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but I need to know the exact time and where to drop things off so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sure — let’s make it simple: Saturday at 10 a.m., and you can drop everything off at the community center parking lot. If that doesn’t work, I can swing by and pick it up instead.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center parking lot works for me. If I run into a snag, I’ll let you know before then.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive’s picking up steam. I’m out running errands now, but I can swing by later if you still need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Ira — I only heard bits second-hand, so that’d help a lot. Swing by later if you can, and I’ll fill you in on what I know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — I’ll finish these errands and stop by later. Looking forward to hearing the details.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help keep an eye on the supplies for the repair drive—what do you still need?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks—can you confirm what’s already covered before I list what’s missing?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got no confirmed list yet, so I can’t say what’s already covered. If you tell me what you have, I’ll help sort out the rest.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and a few tools for the repair drive. Just tell me what you need.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Gus — that’s a huge help. I’ll let you know what tools we need and when to drop by.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Jules — just swing by whenever you’re ready, and I’ll have the tools set aside.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time does the repair drive start, and do you need me to bring anything?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be lovely—thank you! I’m still waiting on the exact start time, but I’ll let you know as soon as I hear, and if you can bring a few extra gloves, that would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Of course—just send me the time when you get it, and I’ll bring extra gloves. Happy to help out.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time window works best for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Faye — that’s really helpful. Any time after 3:30 works best for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, after 3:30 works for me too. I’ll plan around pickup time and help keep it smooth.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Hana, are we still on for the repair drive, and what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, we’re still on — I’m just checking the details first. Could you bring the toolkit and any spare cables you have?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure, I can bring the toolkit and any spare cables I have. Do you want me to come a little early?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, this is for the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, that’s right — it’s for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — thanks for confirming.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Cleo — I’m getting the repair drive organized now, and I’d love your help. Want to tell me which homes or fixes should be at the top of the list?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I’d put the homes with no heat or leaking roofs at the top, then any broken doors or windows. I’ll keep an eye out for supplies and let you know what we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s perfect, Cleo — thank you. I’ll put no-heat and leaking-roof homes first, then doors and windows, and I’ll check back with you on supplies.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little with the repair drive, though I have to keep things simple right now.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Uli — simple is fine. Just tell me what you can handle, and I’ll work around it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can sort and label donations, maybe for an hour at a time. If that helps, I can stop by tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces about the repair drive—what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I think they’re still gathering tools and volunteers, but I’m a bit fuzzy on the details.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, that’s about all I’ve heard too. If you learn when they’re meeting, let me know—I’m happy to help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m in—what do you need me to fix?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m still sorting the list, but I’ll get you the details in a bit.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—just send me the list when it’s ready and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to take on?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Mara — could you handle the tool sign-out table and help greet folks as they arrive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I can handle the tool sign-out table and greet people as they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive right away—folks around here usually show up when they hear there’s a need. Want me to invite a few neighbors too?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’d be great, Quinn—thanks. The more neighbors we can get, the better chance we’ve got of helping everyone out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll start with a few folks on my street and let them know what’s needed. I’ll circle back once I’ve got a couple more neighbors lined up.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m sorry, I’m a bit late—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: No worries — the repair drive is still at the community center parking lot, and we’re sorting donations by the north entrance.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll head to the north entrance and help sort donations.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — if I hear anything about the repair drive, I’ll let you know.
